# Takumi Motion

> Deterministic server-side animation engine: React or HTML -> GIF/WebP/APNG/PNG-sequence/sprite-sheet/still, rendered by the Rust takumi engine.

Documentation built with Astro Starlight, structured after the Diátaxis framework.

## Tutorials

Guided walkthroughs for first-time users.

- [Declarative Banners](/tutorials/declarative-banners): Compose and render banners from templates and timelines — no React components required.
- [Your First Banner](/tutorials/first-banner): Install takumi-motion, define a React banner, and render it to a deterministic WebP in one sitting.

## How-to Guides

Task-oriented recipes for specific goals.

- [CI Quality Gates](/guides/ci-quality-gates): Fail builds on layout shifts, seam breaks, and byte budgets with takumi-motion check and renderWithAudit.
- [Data-Driven Animations](/guides/data-driven-animations): Inject static data at setup and render deterministic charts, count-ups, and stats — no network fetches at render time.
- [Parallel Capture](/guides/parallel-capture): Speed up heavy banners with worker-pool capture — byte-identical output at any worker count.
- [Preview and Inspect](/guides/preview-and-inspect): Choose between filmstrips, CSS previews, storyboards, and stills to verify banners before shipping.
- [Reduce File Size](/guides/reduce-file-size): Cut GIF and WebP bytes with the budget ladder, hold collapse, the X-ray, and the size doctrine.
- [Render Raw HTML](/guides/render-from-raw-html): Turn a plain HTML fragment with CSS into deterministic GIF, WebP, APNG, or still outputs — no React involved.
- [Seamless Loops](/guides/seamless-loops): Make banners repeat forever with byte-identical first and last frames — wrap seams, loop utilities, and the seam audit.

## Reference

API surface: CLI, components, hooks, engine, renderers, lint codes.

- [CLI](/reference/cli): Every takumi-motion command and flag — render, check, preview, storyboard, init, templates, presets, fonts.
- [Core Engine API](/reference/core-engine): createTimeline, compileTimeline, evaluateAt, springs, inertia, easings, interpolation, and OKLCH color.
- [Hooks & Motion Math](/reference/hooks): Frame context hooks and their pure, hook-free companions — springs, interpolation, pulses, noise, and stagger.
- [Lint Codes](/reference/lint-codes): Every TM_* authoring lint code — what it catches, why it matters, and the fix it hints at.
- [Package Exports](/reference/package-exports): The subpath export map of takumi-motion — what each entry point exposes and the runtime requirements.
- [Presets, Themes & Fonts](/reference/presets-and-themes): Banner presets, themes, font catalog, personalities, and the four banner templates with their props.
- [React Components](/reference/react-components): Props and defaults for every component in the takumi-motion/react runtime — Banner, Scene, Layer, charts, materials, particles, and more.
- [Renderers & Reports](/reference/renderers): Options and report shapes for renderBanner, renderReactBanner, renderStill, renderWithAudit, sprite sheets, frame sequences, and HTML.

## Concepts

Architecture, determinism, performance, and size doctrine.

- [Architecture](/explanation/architecture): How authoring, capture, compilation, and the Rust rasterizer connect — from React tree to encoded bytes.
- [Determinism](/explanation/determinism): The frame model, seeded randomness, integer engine time, and the byte-identical guarantee.
- [Performance & Size](/explanation/performance-and-size): What the v1.0 Velocity pass optimized, the benchmark numbers, and the size doctrine behind the encoders.

- [Overview](/): Deterministic server-side animation engine — React or HTML in, GIF/WebP/APNG/sprite-sheet/still out, rendered by Rust.
